name: My Pet Alice
source:
10th episode in My pet Ragnarok series.
Alice serves her master. She loves him so much that follows every his order without complaints. But it may be a step towards ruin...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《我的宠物仙境传说》系列的第十集。
爱丽丝侍奉她的主人。她非常爱他，所以毫无怨言地服从他的一切命令。但这可能是走向毁灭的一步……
